tasks.name: git_clone
tasks.run: git clone -q file:///corpus/repos/flask.git flask && git -C flask checkout -q 3.1.0 && git -C flask log --oneline | wc -l
tasks.desc: clone flask over the git protocol (pack transfer + checkout), then walk history

tasks.name: pip_install
tasks.run: python3 -m venv /work/venv && /work/venv/bin/pip install -q --no-index --find-links /corpus/wheels pytest more-itertools flask requests numpy && /work/venv/bin/python -c 'import numpy, flask, requests'
tasks.desc: create a venv and install pytest, flask, requests, numpy from local wheels

tasks.name: pytest
tasks.setup: python3 -m venv /work/venv && /work/venv/bin/pip install -q --no-index --find-links /corpus/wheels pytest && git clone -q /corpus/repos/more-itertools.git mi && git -C mi checkout -q v10.5.0
tasks.run: cd mi && /work/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests | tail -1
tasks.desc: run the more-itertools test suite (663 tests)

tasks.name: compile_c
tasks.run: make -s -C /work/lua -j2 MYCFLAGS=-std=c99 MYLIBS= CC=gcc >/dev/null 2>&1 || make -C /work/lua -j2 CC=gcc 2>&1 | tail -3; test -x /work/lua/lua && /work/lua/lua -v
tasks.desc: build Lua 5.4 from source with make -j2 (many short gcc processes)

tasks.name: python_imports
tasks.run: for i in $(seq 20); do python3 -c 'import json, asyncio, email.parser, http.client, sqlite3, xml.etree.ElementTree, decimal, unittest' || exit 1; done
tasks.desc: 20 fresh python3 processes importing common stdlib modules (code-exec job startup)

tasks.name: pipe_rtt
tasks.desc: 1-byte pipe round trip between two processes

tasks.name: read_work
tasks.desc: 256 MiB sequential read on /work (page cache warm)
